discovery_reuse_rules: C0-C5 and C5_DAG are discovery-only case identifiers and must not be copied, renamed, parameter-shifted, or used as held-out G4 inputs
BIX1-SAT and BIX2-PERSIST are discovery-only family mechanisms and may appear only as excluded provenance controls, not as confirmation rows

After any post-freeze outcome is inspected, no G4 case JSON, prediction, baseline decision, metric applicability decision, random-stream policy, theory hash, or experiment-script hash may be replaced to improve agreement
Negative, inapplicable, unreachable, and boundary outcomes must remain reportable; they cannot be removed from the bundle after execution
post_freeze_rules: Run the freeze checker before any scientific confirmation command and archive its artifact hashes
Execute scientific commands only after FREEZE_ENTRY.json seals the bundle and only with the runtime and command lock recorded here
Do not inspect, summarize, or backfill outputs before the seal is committed
If a command cannot run in the locked runtime, report it as a frozen-protocol execution failure rather than editing preregistered inputs
Report every inapplicable metric or baseline with its freeze-time reason
